Forgive me, my lady, umm… you're not like most politicians.|Padmé Amidala and Teckla Minnau|}} '''Teckla Minnau''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]] to [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. ==Biography== ===On Naboo=== Shortly before the [[Clone Wars]], [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] returned to [[Naboo]] under the protection of [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. [[Gender|She]] stayed at her [[Varykino]] estate, where she was attended by Teckla Minnau. During one dinner, Teckla served Skywalker a plate of [[fruit]]. ===The Clone Wars=== ====Amidala's aide on Coruscant==== During the Clone Wars, Teckla was on [[Coruscant]] when an [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|attack]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] left the [[planet]] without power. The attack prompted certain members of the [[Galactic Senate]] to support a [[Republic financial reform bill|bill]] that would increase the [[Galactic Republic|Republic's]] spending on the [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]].{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} Following a Senate debate on the proposal, Minnau accompanied Padmé from the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] back to [[Padmé's office|her office]] in the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]]. Minnau brought back a [[datapad]] and waited while Padmé spoke with her close allies, Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] and [[Onaconda Farr]], about defeating the troop increase bill. A night later, when Padmé, bruised and battered after a run-in with [[bounty hunter]]s, returned to [[Padmé's Apartment|her apartment]], Minnau treated her facial wounds with an antiseptic. Though Minnau suggested that she report the incident to the [[Jedi High Council]], the senator refused, as she knew that her assailants had been trying to prevent her from voting against the troop increase. Minnau provided moral support for Padmé, who was losing hope with her prospects of defeating the bill. At Padmé's request, Minnau stayed at the apartment and spoke to Padmé of the effects such spending was having on her family, who were living with limited power and bathing [[water]] in a small village on Naboo. [[File:Teckla-Headdress.png|thumb|left|300px|Teckla hands Padmé her headdress before her Senate speech.]] This prompted Padmé to deliver a speech in the senate, which Teckla witnessed. The senator told her fellow delegates about Teckla and her family, and cited them as an example of the great suffering the Republic's military spending was causing to its people. Because of Teckla's story and the senator's words, the bill was defeated. ====Negotiations on Scipio==== Later during the war, Teckla escorted Padmé on a [[Mission to Scipio|mission]] to [[Scipio]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Amidala sought to secure a new loan from the Banking Clan to aid [[refugee]]s who had been displaced from their homes by the war. Minnau accompanied Amidala to the [[Main Vault]] amidst the icy mountains of Scipio. [[Mak Plain]], a Banking Clan official, received Amidala, Minnau, and their associates at the entrance to the neutral zone surrounding the Main Vault, where all monetary transactions were conducted free of partisanship to the Republic and the Confederacy. While [[Senate Commando]]s remained outside, Minnau followed the senator and the Banking Clan representatives into the neutral zone and proceeded to the Vault's main rotunda. There, Amidala met with the [[Core Five]], the primary leadership of the Banking Clan. As Core Five spokesman [[Clu Lesser]] introduced the special representative who would be directly discussing the terms with Amidala, both Padmé and Teckla were surprised to see [[Rush Clovis]] enter the rotunda.{{TCW|An Old Friend}} That night, Plain showed Padmé and Teckla to their guest quarters, and Teckla thanked Plain before he left. Immediately thereafter, Teckla noticed someone creeping up behind Padmé and shouted a warning. Padmé, having [[Smuggler|smuggled]] an [[ELG-3A blaster pistol]] into the Neutral Zone, aimed her [[blaster]] at the intruder: Clovis. He told Padmé that he needed her help, and though Teckla protested, the senator decided to hear him out and followed him out onto the room's balcony to confer privately. Clovis explained that while he suspected there were no financial funds remaining in the banks, the evidence was out of his reach within the records of the Main Vault, to which only the Core Five were permitted entry. Just then, sniper shots fired by the bounty hunter [[Embo]], who was too far away to be identified, narrowly missed the senators. Clovis pleaded with Padmé to pressure the Core Five into opening access to the Main Vault, then escaped on a [[hover sledge]] that he had parked several [[meter]]s beneath the balcony. After the local [[Muun]] authorities arrived to verify that Amidala was safe, Teckla saw the security agents off. The next morning, after Amidala successfully negotiated access into the Main Vault, the two [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] women accompanied Clovis aboard the [[H-2 executive shuttle|executive shuttle]] to [[Rush Clovis's residence|his personal residence]] in a remote area outside the [[Main Vault fortress|city]]. There, the three discussed a plan to retrieve the hidden files within the Main Vault. Clovis intended to set off an explosive charge at the [[Main Vault power generator|Main Vault's power generator]], which would plunge the entire facility into shutdown. In the brief interlude preceding the backup generator's activation, Amidala would use a device to locate the secret data files and download them from the mainframe. [[File:TecklaTargeted-AOF.png|thumb|right|300px|Teckla targeted by Embo's bowcaster]] The next morning, the three met the Core Five at the Main Vault. After the Core Five had entered the Vault with Amidala, Clovis attempted to sneak off to plant his detonator at the power generator. However, Plain stopped Clovis and pressured him into waiting for Amidala to return, since opening the Vault had been his idea. Noticing Clovis's dilemma, Minnau discreetly took the explosive charge from him and undertook his part of the scheme. She proceeded down several levels to the generator superstructure, and once she had glanced around to make sure no one had spotted her, she placed the detonator onto the structure. Unbeknownst to her, a droid sent by Embo had located her. Embo aimed at her from a long distance away with his [[bowcaster]], and Minnau halted in her tracks when she saw his bowcaster's targeting light on her body. She frantically scanned her surroundings, but before she could pinpoint her attacker, Embo fired a single shot that [[Death|killed]] her. Mere [[second]]s later, Minnau's explosive activated, compromising the entire power grid and allowing Amidala to surreptitiously retrieve the required data files from the Vault mainframe. ===Legacy=== The Muun authorities' following investigation into the power grid failed, and Teckla's body was found at the scene of the bomb site. It was concluded that she had sabotaged the power grid. Although Minnau's murderer went unidentified, Amidala and Clovis used the recovered data files to expose the Core Five as the masterminds of an embezzling scandal that had depleted the banks. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Teckla_serving_fruit.png|thumb|right|160px|Teckla Minnau on Naboo before the Clone Wars]] Teckla was a [[Human]] [[Gender|Female]] who stood at 1.68 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]], 6 inches) tall. She had light skin and [[Color|green]] eyes, and often kept her black [[hair]] covered under her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]] cowl. She was a quiet presence in Senator Amidala's household, often performing tasks unnoticed in the background. Despite this, she was on hand to deliver advice to the senator when needed. Amidala considered her a close friend. ==Skills and abilities== As one of Padmé's handmaidens and her aide, Teckla was proficient at both armed and unarmed combat. She was also well versed in infiltration and security. During her final mission on Scipio, Padmé assigned Teckla to create a diversion, so she could enter the Banking Clan's vaults. She placed a detonator on the generator superstructure, which in turn caused a power outage across the grid, allowing Amidala to download the data files on the Republic, exposing that the Core Five were the masterminds of an embezzling scandal that had depleted the banks. ==Equipment== Minnau wore a blue [[Clothing|dress]] with a light blue bodice.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Then The Clone Wars series used the character as one of Padmé's handmaidens, and pulled her full name from the Databank, thus making the fan-generated name part of George Lucas' storytelling. Neato!|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1490567601633648640|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Then The Clone Wars series used the character as one of Padmé’s handmaidens, and pulled her full name from the Databank, thus making the fan-generated name part of George Lucas’ storytelling. Neato!|archivedate=20220207112347}}}} Teckla Minnau first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[2002]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]] film {{Film|II}}, where she was portrayed by [[Natalie Lewis]]. In the film's script, she was identified as a serving girl.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1490565332209000450|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Teckla has an unusual evolution as a character. Here, in Episode II, she was identified in script as a serving girl (along with Nandi). Teckla is called out specifically in this scene, but is never called a handmaiden. She's played by Natalie Lewis.|archivedate=20220207112329}} She was identified as Teckla in author [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization of the film]].[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] During the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] era, Teckla was given her surname in a [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1490567142697095170|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Then during the Hyperspace Fan Club days, her backstory was put up to be defined by a fan club member as part of the 'What's the Story' feature. She was given the surname Minnau, which was a reference to Nathan Hamill's self-named cameo character in Episode I.|archivedate=20220207112401}} written by "[[Evan Burger|ShadowCultist]]"{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}} through the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature ''[[What's The Story?]]'', which was a reference to [[Nathan Hamill]]'s self-named background character [[Rehtul Minnau]]. Teckla later appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," where she was voiced by [[Ashley Moynihan]]. When Minnau appeared in the episode "[[An Old Friend]]," she was voiced by [[Anna Graves]]. Thanks to her origins as a background character who was expanded upon by a fan and final evolution as a character in ''The Clone Wars'', [[Pablo Hidalgo]] described her character evolution as "unusual" but, ultimately "neat." In the animated series, Teckla is shown to have green eyes, whereas the extra who portrayed her in ''Attack of the Clones'' has brown eyes. ==Appearances== *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} {{1stID|Teckla Minnau}} *{{StoryCite|story=Pursuit of Peace (short story)|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark|audiobook=1}} *{{TCW|An Old Friend}} *{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/pursuit-of-peace-episode-guide|text="Pursuit of Peace" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/an-old-friend-episode-guide|text="An Old Friend" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SW|url=news/a-guide-to-the-royal-handmaidens|text=A Guide to the Royal Handmaidens of Naboo}} *{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Women of Star Wars|cardname=#89: Teckla Minnau|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/216003/cid/14374582/2020-Topps-Women-of-Star-Wars-89-Teckla-Minnau|nobackup=1}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *{{Databank|padme-amidala|Padmé Amidala}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|teckla-minnau|Teckla Minnau}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Teckla Minnau |ja=テクラ・ミナウ |pl=Teckla Minnau |tr=Teckla Minnau }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Minnau, Teckla}} [[Category:Clerical workers and assistants]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Naboo Royal Handmaidens]]
